body: Any more news about this? This is definitely a bug in my app. Is there a temporary workaround I can use?

I think the `normalizeDatetimeValue` method may need to be slightly enhanced (will check if I can contribute here).

As a workaround - you may try using the [yii2-datecontrol extension](http://demos.krajee.com/datecontrol) which can work with any widget but has inbuilt integration with DatePicker, DateTimePicker, and TimePicker from yii2-widgets. It allows you to set a displayTimezone and saveTimezone separately (as well as separate displayFormat and saveFormat). It internally uses PHP `DateTime` class to parse all formats (and internally converts/compares  both ICU and Javascript formats to PHP recognizable date time format)

issue.title: Date formatter and time zones
issue.body:
I am using UTC timestamps in a MySQL table, for example for June 15, 2014:
  SET @@session.time_zone='+00:00';
  INSERT INTO {{%sometable}} (type, day) values (99, UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2014-06-15'));
A query
  SELECT day, (FROM_UNIXTIME(day, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS isodate FROM {{%sometable}} WHERE type = 99;
returns _'day': 1402790400_ and _'isodate': 2014-06-15_ which is correct.

if I use _Yii::$app->formatter->asDate(1402790400)_
it returns _'Jun 15, 2014' on a server in Europe (TZ 'Europe/Madrid', offset 7200 sec)_ -> _correct_.
BUT it returns _'Jun 14, 2014' on a server in California (TZ 'America/Los_Angeles', offset -25200 sec)_ -> _wrong_ in my opinion.

Similar results come out from _Yii::$app->formatter->asTimestamp(<the result of asDate()>)_
In Europe I get _1402790400_ -> correct (same day).
In California I get _1402704000_, which is the UTC timestamp of the previous day.

body: @cebe Dang Carbon looks incredible! I might have to start using that over straight DateTime methods.
The first article does interestingly mention that it is NOT ENOUGH (or not completely correct) for storing timestamps with UTC-offset in a database and still be able to do calculations with this.

you might have an outdated timezone database installed with your ICU version which does not include the change in russian timezones. Check the last paragraph of http://www.yiiframework.com/doc-2.0/guide-tutorial-i18n.html#setting-up-your-php-environment

``` bash
PHP: 5.5.12-2ubuntu4.1
ICU: 52.1
```

On other server with

``` bash
PHP: 5.6.2-1
ICU: 52.1
```

i get the same trouble

And i trying to install pecl extension timezonedb ("Timezone Database Version 2014.9" from phpinfo()). There is no effect... One hour plus...

> ICU: 52.1

according to #5128 this does not include an up to date timezone db so you need to update it as described in the guide.
